package.name: valid8_dual_cell_description
package.description:
Valid8 Dual Robot Cell Description Package
Contains URDF/XACRO description for the Valid8 workcell with two UR5e robots: - nakul_ur5e: Position [-0.6758, 0, 1.03] with -90° yaw, IP 192.168.1.9 - sahadev_ur5e: Position [0.6758, 0, 1.03] with +90° yaw, IP 192.168.1.16
Based on Universal Robots ROS2 Tutorials: https://github.com/UniversalRobots/Universal_Robots_ROS2_Tutorials/tree/main/my_dual_robot_cell
